title: Isoquercitrin Attenuates Oxidative Liver Damage Through AMPK-YAP Signaling: An Integrative In Silico, In Vitro, and In Vivo Study.
authors: Kwon, So-Hyun; Lee, Won-Yung; Kim, Young Woo; Ko, Kwang Suk; Bak, Seon Been; Park, Sun-Dong
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦异槲皮苷通过AMPK-YAP信号通路减轻氧化性肝损伤，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Isoquercitrin, a flavonoid glycoside found in various plants, has demonstrated antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties. However, its hepatoprotective effects and underlying mechanisms against oxidative liver injury remain unclear. In this study, we evaluated the antioxidant and hepatoprotective effects of isoquercitrin using integrated in silico, in vitro, and in vivo approaches. HepG2 cells exposed to arachidonic acid (AA) and iron exhibited oxidative stress-induced apoptosis, which was significantly attenuated by isoquercitrin treatment, as evidenced by increased cell viability and reduced apoptosis-related protein alterations. Isoquercitrin decreased reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation and preserved mitochondrial function in a dose-dependent manner. Molecular docking and Western blot analyses revealed that isoquercitrin activates the LKB1/AMPK pathway, increasing phosphorylation of AMPK and its downstream target ACC, thereby modulating energy metabolism and reducing oxidative stress. This activation was LKB1 dependent, as confirmed in LKB1-deficient HeLa cells. Additionally, isoquercitrin modulated the YAP signaling pathway in hepatic cells. In vivo, isoquercitrin protected mice against carbon tetrachloride-induced liver injury, reducing serum ALT and AST levels and improving histopathological features. These findings suggest that isoquercitrin exerts hepatoprotective effects by activating the LKB1/AMPK pathway and modulating metabolic enzymes, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent against oxidative liver damage.
abstract_zh: 异槲皮苷（Isoquercitrin）是一种存在于多种植物中的黄酮苷，已显示出抗氧化、抗炎和抗癌特性。然而，其针对氧化性肝损伤的保肝作用及潜在机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们通过整合计算机模拟（in silico）、体外（in vitro）和体内（in vivo）方法评估了异槲皮苷的抗氧化和保肝效果。暴露于花生四烯酸（AA）和铁离子的HepG2细胞表现出氧化应激诱导的凋亡，而异槲皮苷处理显著减轻了这种凋亡，表现为细胞活力增加和凋亡相关蛋白变化减少。异槲皮苷以剂量依赖性方式降低活性氧（ROS）生成并维持线粒体功能。分子对接和Western blot分析揭示，异槲皮苷激活LKB1/AMPK通路，增加AMPK及其下游靶标ACC的磷酸化，从而调节能量代谢并减少氧化应激。这种激活依赖于LKB1，在LKB1缺陷的HeLa细胞中得到了证实。此外，异槲皮苷调节肝细胞中的YAP信号通路。在体内，异槲皮苷保护小鼠免受四氯化碳诱导的肝损伤，降低血清ALT和AST水平，并改善组织病理学特征。这些发现表明，异槲皮苷通过激活LKB1/AMPK通路和调节代谢酶发挥保肝作用，凸显其作为对抗氧化性肝损伤治疗剂的潜力。
